name: Respecting Those In Leadership
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor and respect those in leadership as their authority is established by God, as seen in Romans 13:1 which calls for submission to higher powers ordained by God. Exodus 22:28 warns against cursing rulers, emphasizing reverence for those in authority. Leaders are called to serve humbly, exemplified in Matthew 20:26, and to shepherd God’s people faithfully, as described in Acts 20:28. This respect is rooted in a heart guarded with diligence (Proverbs 4:23) and guided by the principle of treating others as we would want to be treated (Matthew 7:12).
